mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", state_key AS "stateKey", value_type_id AS "valueTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_state_fields WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND ability_id = #{abilityId} AND state_key = #{stateKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_state_fields (game_id, ability_id, state_key, value_type_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{abilityId}, #{stateKey}, #{valueTypeId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id, state_key) DO UPDATE SET value_type_id = EXCLUDED.value_type_id, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", state_key AS "stateKey", value_type_id AS "valueTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_state_fields WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, ability_id, state_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_state_fields_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, ability_id, state_key, value_type_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, ability_id, state_key, value_type_id FROM public.ability_state_fields WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id, state_key, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, value_type_id = EXCLUDED.value_type_id
